extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, and members of the public looking for American Heart Association / American Stroke Association press materials and multimedia
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and presentation conventions for AHA/ASA newsroom items and downloadable multimedia (news releases, infographics, photos, transcripts, translations, and related links). Focused on how materials are made available and the usage/attribution expectations for media users.

rubrics_metrics.name: AHA/ASA Multimedia Materials Usage Policy agreement required
rubrics_metrics.description: Please see AHA/ASA Multimedia Materials Usage Policy. I have read the AHA/ASA Multimedia Materials Usage Policy and agree to the terms of use
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Downloads and access to multimedia assets are gated by an explicit acknowledgment/acceptance of the AHA/ASA Multimedia Materials Usage Policy (checkbox/confirmation shown on each downloadable item).

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright attribution on multimedia
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every multimedia asset lists copyright attribution (e.g., 'copyright American Heart Association 2025' or 2023). Users must observe the stated copyright when using images, videos, or infographics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide transcripts for multimedia/infographics
rubrics_metrics.description: Transcript (doc) provided alongside infographics and some multimedia
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Infographics and certain media include a downloadable transcript file (e.g., .doc) to supply text alternatives and support accessibility and reuse by the media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer accessible and translated file formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Accessible Spanish PDF, Simplified Chinese PDF, Traditional Chinese PDF, Spanish news release (to be added)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Newsroom graphics and releases are provided in multiple languages and accessible formats (JPEG, accessible PDFs, translated versions). The page lists specific alternate-language and accessible PDFs for assets and notes when translations will be added.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide direct download links with file metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Download links show file type and file size (e.g., Download (2.5 MB), Download (832.0 kB)) and a 'File Permalink'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each multimedia item includes a clear download link, the file size, and a permalink for reference; this metadata helps journalists assess file suitability before downloading.

rubrics_metrics.name: Link multimedia to relevant news release or guideline page
rubrics_metrics.description: Link to graphic and information - heart.org/hbp | 2025 High Blood Pressure Guideline news release | Spanish news release (to be added)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Graphics and infographics are tied to specific news releases or guideline pages; the newsroom provides links between visual assets and the supporting news release/guideline content to enable proper context and citation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of categorical organization and labeling for newsroom content
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections such as Latest News, Popular, Featured Story, National News, Local News, Spotlight, Multimedia, Conferences and Meetings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Newsroom items are organized and labeled by category/section to help users find appropriate press materials (e.g., National vs Local vs Spotlight) and to denote featured stories and multimedia resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: External-links disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: This link is provided for convenience only and is not an endorsement of either the linked-to entity or any product or service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When the newsroom links to external sites or resources, it includes an explicit disclaimer clarifying that such links are for convenience and do not constitute endorsement.
